content.title: A vision transformer framework with multi-scale temporal attention for automatic highlight detection and semantic understanding in large-scale sports broadcast video
content.abstract: Automatic highlight detection in sports broadcasting requires models that can localise brief impact events and longer narrative arcs at the same time, and produce meaningful semantic descriptions across sports with markedly different broadcast grammars. Hand-crafted pipelines and single-scale deep architectures struggle on all three fronts, and the difficulty compounds when a system is asked to transfer from one discipline to another.
